Pet Travel Notice

Travelers with animals should check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you head to the gate so we can help keep the trip calm and smooth. We can guide you on crate checks, carrier fit, and the small steps that make boarding easier for you and your pet.

If your plans include a stop at Thornwick, please use the pet relief area before you board. <<FACT F016>> Let our team know if your animal needs extra support, and we will do our best to help in a steady, friendly way.

For a simple travel day, keep your pet's essentials close and make sure documents are ready to show when asked. If you are traveling with a nervous pet, give yourself a little extra room to settle in and avoid rushing through the skyport. Aurelia Skyways wants the journey to feel safe and manageable for both you and your companion.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before departure.
